The WebSurfer's search results clearly showed that the 1997 film "Thomas Jefferson" was directed by "Ken Burns" (as seen in the snippet: "Thomas Jefferson is a 1997, two-part American documentary film directed and produced by Ken Burns"). The Planner misread "Ken Burns" as "Ric Burns" (likely confusing the director with his brother, Ric Burns, who is also mentioned in the search results). This initial error led the entire subsequent conversation down the wrong path, searching for Ric Burns' birthplace instead of Ken Burns', until a later correction was made in Step 7.
